title: Costco’s Exclusive ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Trading Card Set Includes 11 Rarity Levels & A Character-Inspired Frame
summary: Fans have a choice between the HUNTR/X or Saja Boys trading card Collector Box, each sold exclusively at Costco.
contentText:

KPop Demon Hunters fans have a new collectible to add to their wish lists. Global trading card brand Kayou has teamed up with Netflix’s hit animated film for a special Collector Box available exclusively for Costco members. Priced at $53.99, the set comes in two versions inspired by HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys.

get costco membership

Each box includes 10 Energy Edition trading card packs inspired by the Oscar-winning movie , with eight cards per pack, bringing the total to 80 cards. The collection spans 130 cards across 11 rarity levels, giving fans plenty of possibilities to explore as they hunt for their favorite characters and rare pulls. Every box also includes a special Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird promotional card and a character-inspired acrylic card frame. Both versions are available on Costco’s website.

HUNTR/X

HUNTR/X fans can choose the Collector Box inspired by the film’s fierce girl group. The difference between this and the Saja Boys Collector Box is the acrylic card frame with the HUNTR/X members featured in the design.

SAJA BOYS

Saja Boys 'KPop Demon Hunters' Trading Cards & Collector Box

Prefer the movie’s charismatic rival group? The Saja Boys Collector Box offers a matching option for fans who want to celebrate the boy band. Like the HUNTR/X edition, it comes with an acrylic card frame featuring the boy band instead.

The Costco-Exclusive KPop Demon Hunters Trading Cards Rarity Levels Explained

- Scenario-E (SE): Includes four “Golden” trading cards , one of each HUNTR/X member and one of the group together.

- Brush Rare (BR): Includes three spotlight trading cards featuring each HUNTR/X member.

- Parallel Creative Rare (CR): Includes eight cards, one for each HUNTR/X and Saja Boys member, in a different international city.

- Special Picture (SP): Includes six HUNTR/X Exclusive trading cards, two for each member of the girl group.

- Legacy Rare (LR): Includes six Saja Boys Exclusive trading cards, one for each member of the group and one featuring the entire group in demon-red clothing.

- Ultra Rare (UR): Includes 13 Signature Cards, featuring one HUNTR/X and Saja Boys member per card.

- Titan Rare (TR): Includes eight cards, one for each HUNTR/X and Saja Boys member, singing on stage.

- Quaint Rare (QR): Includes 24 cards in anime style, featuring the HUNTR/X members, the Saja Boys, demons, a “Rujinu” love-heart card, Sussie, Derpy and animated references to the movie.

- Holo Rare (HR): Includes 24 holographic trading cards depicting memorable movie moments.

- Super Spark Rare (SSR): Includes 16 Concert Ticket trading cards with the HUNTR/X members in two distinct outfits and the Saja Boys in their “Soda Pop” and demon outfits.

- Super Rare (SR): Includes 18 Incoming Calls trading cards featuring HUNTR/X, the Saja Boys, Sussie, Derpy, Bobby, Celine and demons.

What You Need to Know About a Costco Membership

Costco is a membership-based retailer known for its wide selection of groceries, household goods, electronics, clothing and other products at competitive prices. Customers can shop at its warehouses or browse a broader selection through Costco’s website.

A Costco membership is generally required to purchase member-exclusive products, including this Kayou Collector Box. If you’re already a member, ordering online offers a convenient way to add the collectible to your cart without making a trip to a warehouse.
